tools.name: calculate_loan_payment
tools.description: Monthly payment, total interest and yearly amortization for a mortgage, auto or personal loan from the numbers given. Illustration only; not a quote.

tools.name: refinance_break_even
tools.description: Months until a refinance's monthly saving repays its closing costs.

tools.name: estimate_affordability
tools.description: Largest home price whose payment keeps total debt within a debt-to-income limit. Illustration, not a pre-approval.

tools.name: get_mortgage_rates
tools.description: Latest Freddie Mac PMMS national average 30-year and 15-year fixed rates (public data, not a lender quote).

tools.name: loan_estimate_red_flags
tools.description: Scan pasted Loan Estimate / Closing Disclosure text for common red flags and questions to ask. Text scan only; not advice.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free tools and Pro ($12/month or $120/year): Saved scenarios, Weekly national average rate alerts from the public Freddie Mac PMMS survey, PDF comparison of your own scenarios.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Return the hosted checkout URL to buy a plan (pro_monthly or pro_yearly). The buyer completes payment on Stripe; nothing is charged by calling this.
